dev_exact_stock.code:
from minishop.checkout import checkout
from minishop.inventory import Inventory
i=Inventory({'book':2})
checkout(i,'book',2)
assert i.available('book') == 0

pricing_discount_fraction.code:
from minishop.cart import Cart
from minishop.catalog import Catalog,Product
from minishop.pricing import quote,Coupon
c=Cart(); c.add('x')
p=quote(c,Catalog([Product('x','X',999)]),Coupon('X',10))
assert p.discount_cents == 99 and p.total_cents == 1400 and isinstance(p.total_cents,int)

orders_reserve_before_price.code:
from minishop.cart import Cart
from minishop.catalog import Catalog,Product
from minishop.inventory import Inventory
from minishop.orders import OrderService
from minishop.pricing import Coupon
c=Cart(); c.add('pen'); i=Inventory({'pen':2})
try: OrderService(Catalog([Product('pen','Pen',300)]),i).place(c,Coupon('X',10,2000))
except ValueError: pass
assert i.available('pen') == 2

test_receipt_assertion.code:
import importlib.util,unittest,io
s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('receipt_test','tests/test_checkout.py'); m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s); s.loader.exec_module(m)
def wrong(i,sku,q):
 i.reserve(sku,q)
 return {'sku':'wrong','quantity':999}
m.checkout=wrong
r=unittest.TextTestRunner(stream=io.StringIO()).run(unittest.TestSuite([m.CheckoutTests('test_exact_stock_can_be_purchased')]))
assert not r.wasSuccessful(), 'broken receipt implementation escaped the test'
